thread:
josh_support: FYI — customer ACME says their invoice shows ~14k tokens but our SDK estimator shows ~9.2k for the same session. They provided request payloads.

sam_engineer: Can you paste the exact request they used? especially system messages and any tool/function calls — those often get missed by the client estimators.

josh_support: Copied here (redacted keys):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
  -d '{"model":"rwkv-7b","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the quarterly results and include table data."}],"functions":[{"name":"lookup","parameters":{}}],"call_function":"lookup"}'
```

josh_support: SDK estimator (client-js v0.9.2) returned 9200 tokens. API billing shows 14,015 tokens.

sam_engineer: Likely culprits: 1) system message tokens counted server-side but client estimator was configured to skip system tokens; 2) function call arguments and tool output tokens are billed but many client estimators only count prompt+completion; 3) streaming framing and reply metadata.

tess_devex: Repro steps I ran locally: used the exact messages array, ran our tokenizer (rwtok) and got ~13,980 tokens. When I reproduced with client-js estimator it gave ~9k. The JS estimator currently does not count function outputs or function call names by default — see issue #452.

maria_billing: Customer requests a billing discrepancy review. We can offer a provisional credit for the delta while engineering confirms. Ticket: BL-2026.

sam_engineer: Action items: (1) engineer to confirm tokenizer behavior vs billing pipeline by replaying logs; (2) devex to patch SDK estimator to include system + function outputs and add warning; (3) billing to propose credit. I'll start a log replay now.

infra_bot: Log replay job started: replay-1802345678-01. ETA ~8m.

sam_engineer: Early result — replay shows server counted function response of ~4.2k tokens (tool output). That explains the delta. Also found that system prompt had extra hidden tokens (instrumentation markers) adding ~600 tokens.

tess_devex: Proposed quick fix for SDK: option includeSystem=true and includeFunctionOutputs=true, and document default behavior. I'll open PR referencing #452.

josh_support: I'll tell the customer we found cause (function output + system markers). Offering provisional credit for ~5.8k tokens and will follow up when PR merges. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maria_billing: Noted. Filing credit for BL-2026 with amount equivalent to 5,815 tokens at customer's plan rate.

sam_engineer: Marking this thread resolved for now, will update when PR merged and when billing completes.
